verdict.rationale: Pilot is a managed bookkeeping service, so transaction-categorization features are a fair question to ask of it. A customer reports that Pilot's bank and card integrations "handle all of the transaction classification" for them. That is a done-for-you service, though, not automatic categorization suggestions shown to the founder. Nothing in the evidence shows suggestions surfaced to the user or a system that learns from the user's corrections.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections
